note: Annual election of one councillor in each of the 15 wards of Belfast Corporation (the member retiring in rotation), nominations Thursday 5 January, poll Monday 16 January 1933. After John Kennedy withdrew in St George's, ten members were returned unopposed and five wards were contested; the Unionists gained Dock from Labour and lost Shankill to Robert Hill of the Corporation Tenants' Association (Belfast News-Letter, 6, 7 and 17 January 1933). Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Corrected from the Belfast Corporation register of members (PRONI LA/7/1/CA/1/3): the name is Robert Joseph Graves as the register writes it (previously Robert Joseph Groves, from the newspaper source; the printed form is kept as printed).
